problem_text: The product of all positive real numbers x satisfying the equation x^(log_{2026} x / 20) = 26x (i.e., the 20th root of x^(log_{2026} x) equals 26x) is an integer P. Find the number of positive integer divisors of P.
notes: Let y = log_{2026}(x). Equation reduces to y^2 - 20y - 20*log_{2026}(26)=0. By Vieta's, y1+y2=20, so product of x values = 2026^20 = 2^20 * 1013^20. Divisors = (20+1)(20+1) = 441. Verified by SymPy (1013 is prime).
